name: Supplier delivery date check
summary: The purchasing or operations person gets one comparison from the open purchase orders and the supplier replies: promised and revised dates side by side, the orders each change puts at risk, and the follow-ups still unanswered. No supplier is contacted.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own design, written from its published map of supply chain and inventory work: open purchase order, supplier reply, follow-up and dependent-order exports with set column headers that stop on a mismatch; three grades of supplier reply, of which only a written confirmation or a call record fixes a date; the date relied on, the days moved and the past-due count; each dependent order tested against its ship-by date with the receiving days added; and the lists of unanswered follow-ups and of lines that need one.
